definitions.explanation: Having practical value or serving a useful purpose. A somewhat formal alternative to words like {便利|べんり} or {役に立つ|やくにたつ}, often used in written or academic contexts.

examples.japanese: {有用|ゆうよう}な{情報|じょうほう}を{得|え}た。
この{研究|けんきゅう}は{社会的|しゃかいてき}に{有用|ゆうよう}だ。
{有用|ゆうよう}な{人材|じんざい}を{確保|かくほ}するために、{企業|きぎょう}は{待遇|たいぐう}の{改善|かいぜん}に{取|と}り{組|く}んでいる。
examples.english: Companies are working on improving employee benefits in order to secure talented people.

notes:
USAGE:
{有用|ゆうよう} is a na-adjective ({形容動詞|けいようどうし}) used primarily in formal writing, academic texts, and business contexts. It modifies nouns with な: {有用|ゆうよう}な{情報|じょうほう}.

Compared to {便利|べんり} (convenient) and {役|やく}に{立|た}つ (to be helpful), {有用|ゆうよう} sounds more formal and is more common in written language.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {有用|ゆうよう}な{情報|じょうほう}: useful information
- {有用|ゆうよう}な{人材|じんざい}: talented/useful personnel
- {有用|ゆうよう}な{資源|しげん}: useful resources
- {有用|ゆうよう}{性|せい}: usefulness, utility
